avis.texte: Let me start by saying, I don't normally write reviews, but i read to many review saying this sunscreen leaves a white cast....NAH! avis.titre: Stained my rug — no warning anywhere, no resolution offered
avis.texte: Loved the silky texture, but a small amount dripped on a bath rug and left a permanent white stain that survived a full wash and dry cycle. I looked more closely at the ingredients, and this formula is loaded with silicones (5+), which is likely why it transfers so easily onto fabric. I looked for a staining warning before buying and after: not on MDSolarSciences.com, not on the retailer sites I bought from, and not on the tube itself (a warning exists only in tiny print on the box, which most people throw away). When I asked to be made whole for the damage, I was told they couldn't process a refund since I didn't buy directly from their site (despite offering in advance to provide receipts). No alternative resolution was offered. I recommend staying away from this product unless you want to risk ruining your fabrics.
